<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">GeoPlace</span>
extends java.lang.Object</pre>
<div class="block"><p>GeoPlace struct represents a location object:
 such as a country, a city, a point of interest (POI) etc.
 It can be used for PersonalPlace creation, in order to provide search on custom places.</div>
</li>
</ul>
